items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I wrote out some things for the three horns, and we rehearsed with J.R. until he got us... He finally got a gig for us in Ada, Oklahoma.

ctx.x: And what you picked up from...

And what I picked up from other musicians, yeah. So I wrote out some things for the three horns, and we rehearsed with J.R. until he got us... He finally got a gig for us in Ada, Oklahoma. We went to Ada to play for dancing, that dime a dance thing, you know...
